Visitor skips definition list items from output

```go title="Go"
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	htmd "github.com/xberg-io/html-to-markdown/packages/go/v3"
)

type testVisitorVisitorDefinitionListSkip struct {
	htmd.BaseVisitor
}

func (v *testVisitorVisitorDefinitionListSkip) VisitDefinitionDescription(ctx htmd.NodeContext, text string) htmd.VisitResult {
	return htmd.VisitResultSkip()
}
func (v *testVisitorVisitorDefinitionListSkip) VisitDefinitionTerm(ctx htmd.NodeContext, text string) htmd.VisitResult {
	return htmd.VisitResultSkip()
}

func main() {
	options := htmd.ConversionOptions{}
	visitor := &testVisitorVisitorDefinitionListSkip{}
	options.Visitor = visitor
	result, err := htmd.Convert(`<p>Glossary:</p><dl><dt>Term A</dt><dd>Definition of term A</dd><dt>Term B</dt><dd>Definition of term B</dd></dl><p>End of glossary</p>`, &options)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	fmt.Printf("%+v\n", result.Content)
}
```
